summary: Iteration 215s - Studio Billing: Monthly class invoicing + Pro-rata smoothing. All backend tests passed (21/22, 1 skipped). All frontend tests passed for Invoicing tab and Plan editor smoothing/course blocks.

success_rate.backend: 95% (21/22 tests passed, 1 skipped - no draft invoices for status update test)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded Billing Test member with 3 April 2026 bookings at £12/class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 215s adds two studio features: (1) Monthly class invoicing - operator picks a month, previews per-member totals from booked/attended classes, generates invoices. (2) Pro-rata smoothing - plans can set smoothed:true + smoothed_annual_pence + smoothed_months for predictable monthly payments. Backend endpoints tested: POST /api/memberships/billing/monthly-invoice/preview (returns member_count/total_pence/invoices[], respects include_attended_only and default_per_class_pence), POST /api/memberships/billing/monthly-invoice/generate (persists invoices, idempotent, status defaults to draft), GET /api/memberships/billing/invoices (filterable by period/status), PATCH /api/memberships/billing/invoices/{id}/status (updates status, 404 for unknown), POST /api/memberships/billing/invoices/{id}/send (400 when no email, 200/502 with email), GET /api/member/invoices (member portal read-only), POST/PATCH /api/memberships/plans with smoothed fields, GET /api/memberships/plans/{plan_id}/smoothing-preview. Frontend verified: Invoicing tab (data-testid='mbr-invoicing') with Period dropdown, Refresh preview button, Generate invoice button, preview table, history table, attended-only checkbox. Plans tab: New plan dialog shows smoothing block (data-testid='mbr-plan-smoothed-block') for recurring plans with toggle and annual/months inputs, course block (data-testid='mbr-plan-course-block') for course plans with template dropdown, session count, start date. Regression: S3 OG cache working (fresh→cache transition, identical bytes).
